message: I am another one that T-Netix has messed with.  Same deal, my son was calling me collect and I was paying my bill and out of the blue my phone line was blocked.  No explanation at all.  I finally got a hold of T-netix and had to set my account up so my son could call me.  I argued with the operator that it is my perogative to accept his collect calls and pay for them on my regular bill.  She totally ignored me and went on with her questions.  If I want to accept the collect calls it should be my decisions not T-netix.  I hate this and wish there was something I could do.
